decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9822. Series context: trend strength 0.8234 and seasonal strength 0.2727; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.014); 7 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.882.
